about_the_game:
You are not alone.

In ShadowKnot, every step you take is mirrored by a second self — your shadow — moving under inverted gravity. You control both characters simultaneously, connected by a shared energy pool and an invisible bond that limits how far they can drift apart.

The world does not forgive hesitation.
Platforms collapse, timing is unforgiving, and your shadow is never just a reflection — it is a responsibility.

This is a game about control, consequence, and coordination. Progress requires mastering momentum, understanding spatial tension between both characters, and making deliberate choices under pressure.

There are no enemies to defeat — only environments to survive.
